editorial.editorial_summary: AdCreative.ai is a paid AI creative platform for generating ad assets and variants. Its published feature set includes creative scoring, video generation, custom templates and competitor insights. Plans are credit- and brand-limited, so buyers should compare the included monthly credits with their campaign volume before subscribing.
